seo.title: About
seo.description: Dr Lauretta Ogbum is a psychotherapist, counsellor and coach, founder and lead therapist of Activator Coaching Academy, and author of Love Intentionally.

hero.title: Understanding yourself. Building healthier relationships.
paragraphs: I am a psychotherapist, counsellor and coach. I work with people who are carrying more than they let on: anxiety, grief, emotional exhaustion, relationship difficulties or a sense of having lost touch with who they are.

Many of the people I work with are managing. They go to work, care for their families and meet their responsibilities. From the outside, everything may look fine. But beneath the surface, they may be struggling with emotions they do not understand, experiences they have not processed or problems they have been carrying alone.
You do not have to wait until everything falls apart before seeking support.

approach.title: Therapy should be a space where you feel safe enough to be honest and supported enough to make meaningful changes.
paragraphs: My approach is compassionate, practical and direct. I listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions and help you recognise the patterns influencing your emotions, decisions and relationships. I will not simply tell you what you want to hear. Sometimes, growth requires us to confront uncomfortable truths and consider a different way forward. I do this with care, never judgement.
In couples therapy, I do not take sides. My role is to help both partners understand each other, communicate more effectively and make informed decisions about their relationship.

I also believe in being honest about the therapeutic process. Some concerns can be addressed in a relatively short period; others require more time. I will not promise quick fixes, but I will work with you towards meaningful, realistic goals.

helpWith.title: My practice supports individuals and couples navigating:

items.title: Emotional wellbeing
items.body: Anxiety, stress, low mood, grief, trauma and burnout.

items.title: Relationships and marriage
items.body: Communication difficulties, recurring conflict, emotional distance, premarital counselling and relationship decisions.

items.title: Self-worth and personal growth
items.body: Confidence, identity, self-awareness and recurring personal patterns.

items.title: Life transitions
items.body: Separation, divorce, miscarriage, bereavement and other significant life changes.

helpWith.note: Relationships and marriage are central to my work, but I also support individuals seeking to understand themselves better and navigate difficult experiences with greater clarity.

beliefs.title: Four things I will say out loud.
beliefs.intro: These are the principles that guide my work. They shape how I approach therapy, relationships and the conversations we have together. I believe you deserve to know them before we begin.

credentials.title: Training, practice and professional contributions

items.label: Academic Qualifications
items.detail: PhD in Psychology, alongside postgraduate qualifications in psychology, peace studies and conflict resolution.

items.label: Professional Memberships
items.detail: Member of the British Psychological Society (BPS), the Counselling Association of Nigeria (CASSON), and the Life Coaches Association of Nigeria (LCAN).

items.label: Founder and Lead Therapist, Activator Coaching Academy
items.detail: Supporting individuals and couples through psychotherapy, counselling and relationship-focused work.

items.label: Author and Relationship Educator
items.detail: Author of *Love Intentionally: Practical Wisdom on Communication, Trust, and Intimacy in Modern Relationships* and co-author of *The ABC of Marriage*.

credentials.note: Through my therapeutic practice, writing and professional engagements, I am committed to helping people better understand themselves, navigate relationship challenges and build healthier connections.

book.title: Love Intentionally
book.intro: Practical wisdom on communication, trust and intimacy in modern relationships.

closing.title: Twenty-five years married. Still learning.
paragraphs: My husband and I have been married for over 25 years. That experience does not make me an authority on anyone else's marriage, but it has taught me that lasting relationships require more than love. They require communication, understanding, patience and a willingness to keep growing together.
I bring that personal perspective, alongside my professional training and experience, to my work with individuals and couples.
closing.tagline: Every relationship has a story. Let us work towards making yours healthier.
